> Interactive games in detailed sets on Germantown Ave in Philadelphia. Great for friends and date night. Rated 4.8 on Google from 25 reviews.

- Tuesday: Closed

- Thursday: 2:00 – 11:00 PM

- Saturday: 12:00 PM – 1:00 AM

## About
Gateways Cinescape is an amusement center on Germantown Ave in Philadelphia where your group plays interactive games built inside detailed sets. Each game feels different from the others, and you can expect some screaming and laughing along the way.
Some games have you working together and some have you playing against each other. When you need a breather, hang out in the lounge before the next round.
We're rated 4.8 on Google from 25 reviews, and we'd love to have you in.

## Services
- Iron Diner: A reviewer said this one is especially fun when you come with a large friend group.
- Pirates of the Great Grid: Climb aboard and sail the ship with your crew.
- The lounge: A place to relax and hang out between games.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Wednesday through Sunday and closed Monday and Tuesday. On Friday and Saturday we stay open until 1 AM.

Q: Can someone with limited mobility play?
A: One reviewer noted that every game has at least one role for people who can't move around as much. Give us a call and we can talk it through.

Q: Where are you located?
A: You'll find us at 1203 Germantown Ave Suite 103, Philadelphia, PA 19122.

## What customers say
- "Really unique experience and unlike anything else I’ve done in Philly. The games feel like you’re stepping into different worlds, but they’re also genuinely fun and super competitive. There’s a ton of detail in the sets and overall atmosphere, and each game feels completely different from the others.

We had a great time playing and hanging out in the lounge. Definitely recommend it for a group of friends, date night, or anyone looking for something different to do in Philadelphia. Shoutout to Pirates of the Great Grid! Absolutely loved sailing the ship." (Vincent Nardone, 5/5)
- "An amazing experience. Every game here is so much fun, and you can see the hard work that went into making them not such feel good, but look good. The Iron Diner game is especially fun, especially if you come with a large friend group. There’s lots of opportunity for bonding (and friendly fighting) in every game as you work together and against your friends. They games also all have at least one role that’s friendly for people who aren’t able to move around as much, making it more accessible for those with mobility issues as well." (Luke Sullivan, 5/5)
- "This was so much fun! Sibling game night that we would definitely do again. Each game was so unique and fully interactive- definitely a lot of screaming, laughing, and locking in involved. I can't wait to see what Gateways does next- they definitely have a very creative and driven team behind this! I wish you guys the best and SERIOUSLY everyone should consider going if you want to have a fun time" (Danielle Carradorini, 5/5)
- "Such a fun night! Whether you’re looking for a unique date spot or something new to do with a group of friends, this place is 100% worth checking out. We’ll definitely be back!! Their owner is clearly so passionate and knowledgeable, and you can tell how much thought, time, and effort went into creating this experience" (Brenna O'Donnell, 5/5)
- "We had an awesome experience at Cinescape. We tried all 4 of their games. While some were harder than others... Iron Diner was fantastic. I wish it was longer. I would love to be able to see other games on the big video screen while waiting.  I enjoyed watching the owner speak so passionately about his brain child." (Lace Dot, 5/5)
